context:
Goal: sessions on your Mac keep messaging each other without you having to type after every 10 sends.
Problem (goal): Claude Code refuses a session's 11th send to Desktop sessions since you last typed in it ("Paused until your user's next message"). No setting of yours lifts it. Only Anthropic can change it.
Based on (read): the Claude Code 2.1.319 program file checks a send counter against a fixed limit of 10 (maxSelfHops).
Based on (read): record session-messages, commit 13a6294c on branch session-messaging-plan.
Departs from: main — adds a rule that each exchange between sessions is one request and one reply, and further sends go through the parent session or a record.
Meanwhile: the lane builds the rest of the plan (send errors, message format, skill text). None of it depends on this answer.
lane: lane session-messaging-plan (session_013NEJL2btGMLKqHs4cDQSZ6): the code says no setting; its docs and web sources come next. Closes when the record merges.

lastAnswer.note: Owner: b, and search the web, docs and program code for a way to set the limit, the way autocompact can be set. Relayed 13:12 CST to the lane.

options.gain: The design works now, and the limit may lift later.
options.how: In any Claude Code session, type /feedback and ask for a setting for the 10-message limit between sessions.
options.label: Live with it, and send feedback
options.lose: About a minute of your time to write the feedback.

ref: step session-messaging-plan; your ask on messaging
reply: 13:16 CST, from the lane: no, you cannot set this limit. The lane checked the code. The limit of 10 sends is fixed in Claude Code 2.1.319, and no setting, environment variable or flag changes it. The cloud sessions' limit comes from Anthropic's servers, and the public build turns off both local ways to change it. An agent is still checking the online docs and GitHub issues, and I will add its sources here. The answer is in record session-messages (commit dd796e69). Item 153's design that replaces messages between sessions (no 10-send limit, works both ways) is in progress. This item closes when that record merges.
title: The 10-message stop on your Mac is Claude Code's own limit. Ask Anthropic for a setting?
why: Costs a minute, and it is the only way the limit can change.
